claim.value: Accounts still awaiting their publication opportunity cannot yet establish failure to publish.
claim.scope: A temporal limit while the relevant publication opportunity remains pending.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly supplies the pending-opportunity condition and the limit on failure attribution.

signal_basis.value: Document intended roster timing, define an observation window covering the intended publication opportunity, and follow unresolved accounts while separately reporting those whose opportunity has not yet occurred.
signal_basis.scope: Assessment of first publication relative to the relevant opportunity; intended dates may change, and the observations are proposed rather than completed findings.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans supply the timing documentation, observation window, separate treatment of pending opportunities, and qualifications concerning changing dates and prospective observations.
No unresolved empirical relation is needed for this supported temporal limit.

rationale: Given the specified opportunity-based observation window, an account whose publication opportunity remains pending has not yet supplied a completed observation of failure to publish. Separately reporting such accounts licenses the claim within its temporal bounds.
uncertainty: Intended roster dates may change. The claim establishes neither eventual publication nor eventual failure.
